Class WorkoutStats

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.util.WorkoutStats
public final class WorkoutStats extends Object
Turns raw workout rows into the numbers the Dashboard and Workout History pages display.

Contains no JavaFX types, so every method here can be unit tested with plain JUnit — no test harness, no visible window.

  • Method Details

    • volumeByDate

      public static List<WorkoutStats.DatedVolume> volumeByDate(List<WorkoutStats.Sample> samples, int limit)
      Groups samples into one entry per session date and adds up the reps.

      Samples arrive newest-first (WorkoutDAO sorts by id descending). The result is flipped to oldest-first so a chart reads left to right, then trimmed to the most recent limit sessions so the bars stay wide enough to read.

      Parameters:
      samples - one entry per logged exercise, newest first
      limit - the maximum number of sessions to return; 0 or less means no limit
      Returns:
      one entry per session, oldest first

    • sessionsThisWeek

      public static int sessionsThisWeek(List<LocalDate> dates, LocalDate today)
      How many of the given session dates fall in the same week as today, counting a week as Monday through Sunday.

      today is a parameter rather than being read from the clock inside, so a test can pin it to a known date instead of behaving differently on a Sunday.

      Parameters:
      dates - the dates of logged sessions; null entries are ignored
      today - the date to treat as today
      Returns:
      the number of sessions in the current week

    • percentOf

      public static int percentOf(double current, double target)
      Progress towards a target as a percentage, capped at 100 and never negative. A target of zero or less returns 0 rather than dividing by zero.
      Parameters:
      current - the amount achieved so far
      target - the goal amount
      Returns:
      a percentage from 0 to 100

    • currentStreak

      public static int currentStreak(List<LocalDate> dates, LocalDate today)
      Consecutive days with at least one workout, ending today.

      If nothing is logged today the streak is still alive as long as yesterday has a workout, because the user can still train today. Anything older returns 0, so a workout three weeks ago no longer shows a "current streak". Duplicate dates count once; null and future dates are ignored.

      Parameters:
      dates - the dates of logged workouts
      today - the date to treat as today
      Returns:
      the current streak in days, or 0 if there is none

    • weeklyBuckets

      public static List<WorkoutStats.WeekBucket> weeklyBuckets(List<WorkoutStats.DayVolume> days, LocalDate today, int weeks)
      Adds daily reps into the last weeks calendar weeks (Monday to Sunday), oldest first, ending with the week containing today. Every week gets a bucket, even with zero reps, so the chart has no gaps. Days outside the window are ignored.
      Parameters:
      days - daily rep totals; null entries are ignored
      today -
      weeks - how many weeks to include; 0 or less returns an empty list
      Returns:
      one bucket per week, oldest first
